content.text: Cash-out saved me plenty. Backed Bangladesh at 2.10 pre-match, they win the toss and get 40/0 in five overs, odds drop to 1.55 — I cash out for a guaranteed profit and go to sleep. No stress about a collapse.
Two odds formats at 520BD:

items: Decimal odds (default): total return per ৳1 wagered.

content.text: Fractional odds: UK style. 3/1 means ৳3 profit per ৳1 stake plus your stake returned.
Switch formats in your account settings. If you're new, stick with decimal — you just multiply stake by odds and you know your return.
Quick probability check: 1 ÷ decimal odds = implied probability.
1.50 odds → 66.7% implied
2.00 odds → 50% implied
5.00 odds → 20% implied
Useful for sniffing out value — if you think Bangladesh has a real 55% chance and the odds show 2.10 (47.6% implied), that's a bet worth considering.
